verdict.rationale: Docs confirm live_url/live-view to watch an agent session in real time and explicitly state users can 'take over and interact with the browser yourself' when needed, directly matching the story. However, there's no documented workflow for detecting when the agent is 'stuck', no hands-on/independent confirmation of the handoff mechanics, and no replay/debugging tooling described beyond live viewing. missing for 10: independent verification of the takeover UX, stuck-detection/alerting mechanism, and session replay/debugging after handoff.
